description: Consumer probes for emitted brim clearance and zero-disabled ear decimation. Run with fff_print_skirt_brim_tests and tests/controls/skirt_brim.json.

mutants.description: Ignore configured brim-object gap for ordinary outer brims. The emitted-path-to-model clearance must fail to increase across the 0, 1, and 2 mm rows.

Treat only the registered zero sentinel as the default 1 mm decimation distance while preserving positive 1 and 2 mm controls. Under the fixture angle that includes the 126.87-degree triangle tip, the zero-row G1 segment witness must disappear.
